subject: Approval request: enable Suggestions (Optimize) beta flags in prod for initial cohort (read-only)
related_links: PR: redwood#18723 (feature flag plumbing + allowlist admin tool)
PR: redwood#18695 (audit log entries + RBAC check)
body:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, Feb 8, 2026 at 9:12 AM
Subject: Approval request: enable Suggestions (Optimize) beta flags in prod for initial cohort (read-only)

Requesting approval to enable the Suggestions beta feature flags in prod for the initial allowlisted cohort.

Scope / what changes in prod (beta):
- Read-only UI in Console: Optimize -> Suggestions list + detail drawer
- Data is fetched from suggestions-service read endpoints
- Gated behind server + client flags + per-tenant allowlist
- RBAC: viewing requires existing “Optimize: View” permission; audit logs are written on read access

Flags:
- console.suggestions_beta (client)
- bff.suggestions_beta (server)
- suggestions_service.read_enabled (service)

Initial cohort (allowlist, 6 tenants):
- 2 enterprise Dedicated tenants + 4 hosted API tenants (mix of steady + variable traffic)
- CS owners aligned; support enablement in flight

Risk assessment summary (high-level):
1) Tenant isolation / data exposure
- Risk: suggestions derived from usage/cost telemetry; must not cross workspaces.
- Mitigations: tenant scoping enforced in suggestions-service and BFF; staging bug from last week fixed + regression test added; audit logs enabled for reads.

2) Savings estimate correctness / overpromising
- Risk: UI could show misleading “savings” if telemetry is stale / baselines drift.
- Mitigations: “estimated” wording; basis-of-estimate panel; stale telemetry handling shows “insufficient data” vs. a number; dashboards + stale estimate alerts.

3) Reliability / performance
- Risk: suggestions-service adds latency or 5xxs impacting Console.
- Mitigations: UI is best-effort; failure shows a non-blocking error state; request timeouts configured; p95/5xx alerts configured; feature flag rollback is immediate.

4) Customer impact if suggestion is wrong
- Note: beta is read-only (no one-click apply), so risk is primarily trust/support load, not runtime regressions.

Rollback plan (if incident or security concern):
- Immediate: disable allowlist for impacted tenant(s)
- Disable bff.suggestions_beta (server) -> stops UI from calling service
- Disable console.suggestions_beta (client) -> hides UI
- If needed: disable suggestions_service.read_enabled
- Post-mortem and re-enable only after fix + validation

Proposed rollout window:
- Tue 2/10 10:00–12:00 PT (aligned with release train)

Asks:
1) Connor: approve rollout window + confirm release steps
2) Rafael: SRE sign-off on dashboards/alerts + pause criteria
3) Naomi: security sign-off that RBAC/audit logging is sufficient for beta
4) Marissa/Aditya: product sign-off on cohort + beta messaging expectations

Happy to jump on a quick 15-min if there are open questions.

-Dylan

—
Dylan Brooks
Engineering Lead, Console & Tooling
Redwood Inference


From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, Feb 8, 2026 at 10:01 AM
Subject: Re: Approval request: enable Suggestions (Optimize) beta flags in prod for initial cohort (read-only)

SRE sign-off with two conditions:

1) Pause criteria is explicit and owned. I suggest:
- suggestions-service 5xx > 2% for 10 min OR p95 latency > 1.5s for 15 min -> disable service flag
- stale_estimate_ratio > 20% across cohort for > 2 hours -> disable cohort allowlist (or suppress numbers)

2) Oncall has the runbook link in the alert description and knows this is “beta = OK to disable quickly.”

If you’re already using the dashboards from redwood#18702, that covers most of what I need.

-Rafael


From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, Feb 8, 2026 at 10:27 AM
Subject: Re: Approval request: enable Suggestions (Optimize) beta flags in prod for initial cohort (read-only)

Security sign-off for beta, assuming:

- RBAC check is enforced server-side (BFF) and not just client gating.
- Audit logs include: actor, workspace/tenant id, suggestion ids accessed (or at least “SuggestionsViewed” with tenant scope), and timestamp.
- No raw prompts or request payloads are included in the response. (Usage-derived aggregates are fine.)

I’m OK with the initial cohort as long as we keep this allowlist-only and don’t expand without another quick review.

Naomi

—
Naomi Feldman
Security & Compliance Product Reviewer
Redwood Inference


From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, Feb 8, 2026 at 10:58 AM
Subject: Re: Approval request: enable Suggestions (Optimize) beta flags in prod for initial cohort (read-only)

Confirming:
- RBAC is enforced in BFF before calling suggestions-service (see redwood#18695).
- Audit logs are written on read access at the BFF layer.
- No prompts/request bodies are returned by suggestions-service. “Basis of estimate” is token metering + aggregate counters only.

Also: the tenant scoping regression test was added after the staging issue (workspaces A/B leak).

-Chloe


From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, Feb 8, 2026 at 11:34 AM
Subject: Re: Approval request: enable Suggestions (Optimize) beta flags in prod for initial cohort (read-only)

Product sign-off from Console side.

Two asks before Tuesday:
- Make sure the empty/insufficient-data state is what we reviewed (don’t show “$0 savings” as a number).
- Add the “beta/read-only” tag in the header so CS doesn’t have to explain why there’s no Apply button.

Otherwise OK to proceed with the cohort + read-only scope.

Marissa


From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, Feb 8, 2026 at 12:09 PM
Subject: Re: Approval request: enable Suggestions (Optimize) beta flags in prod for initial cohort (read-only)

+1 from Optimize.

For cohort: please keep the “high variance” customer in the 2nd wave unless we’re confident the risk label/rationale is stable enough (last week’s feedback was pretty sharp on that).

Also: if stale telemetry blocks showing numbers, that’s acceptable for beta; better to show “insufficient data” than a wrong estimate.

-Aditya


From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, Feb 8, 2026 at 2:46 PM
Subject: Re: Approval request: enable Suggestions (Optimize) beta flags in prod for initial cohort (read-only)

Approved for Tue 2/10 10:00–12:00 PT.

Release plan:
- 9:45 PT: confirm flags are OFF + allowlist empty in prod
- 10:05 PT: enable suggestions_service.read_enabled
- 10:15 PT: enable bff.suggestions_beta
- 10:30 PT: enable console.suggestions_beta (client)
- 10:35 PT: add allowlist entries one-by-one (pause after each for smoke check)

Rollback is as you outlined; we’ll keep Connor (me) as the “single throat to choke” during the window.

Please drop the final cohort tenant ids in the release ticket by EOD Monday.

-Connor

—
Connor O’Brien
Release Engineering
Redwood Inference
